note: Canonical-home rows naming an artifact no technique declares. Every entry carries a verdict and a named rationale, so real debt and a correct-by-design row are not the same silence. fix-later = real debt, suppressed but counted. A finding absent from this file is untriaged and reported; an entry that matches nothing is stale and reported. There is no regenerate flag — an entry is a human judgement. The four entries here were surfaced when the guard was authored during the 2026-09-09 work-package canon audit: the guard's motivating defect was a work-package row naming the guide resource `knowledge-base-research.md` instead of the artifact `kb-research.md`, which the same pass fixed. These four are the same class in workflow-design, whose four register and log artifacts are named as canonical homes while no technique declares them. work-package is the worked example of the fix — its `manage-registers` operations declare `follow-ups.md` and `deferred-items.md` under `#### artifact`, so its equivalent rows resolve.

rationales.register-artifact-undeclared: A cross-activity register or log that some operation appends to without declaring it under `#### artifact`, so the artifact contract does not carry the filename its canonical-home row names. Real debt: the conformance gate bound with the map asks every template to link a home the artifact contract does not know about. The fix is to declare the file on the operation that writes it, as work-package's manage-registers operations already do.
